text:
elle: Heads-up — CI is red on master, job gpu-inference-ubuntu-22.04 #4567 failing with driver/kernel errors. Logs attached below.

ci-bot: Job gpu-inference-ubuntu-22.04 #4567 failed — stage: test (exit 1). Summary: NVML timeout / Xid 31 seen on node host-12.

cheng: I saw similar after yesterday's base-image bump. Can you paste `nvidia-smi -q` and the dmesg Xid lines?

elle: Paste from the failing job (trimmed):
```
NVIDIA-SMI 535.54       Driver Version: 535.54       CUDA Version: 12.2
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                       GPU Memory |
|  GPU       PID   Type   Process name                             Usage      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

elle: dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (31): 0x0000000a, pid=3421, channel=00000010, context=0x00000000
[ 1234.568123] NVRM: GPU at 00000000:3B:00.0 has fallen off the bus.
```

sarah: paging @infra-oncall — looks like a driver vs kernel module mismatch after the image update. Might be flaky across a subset of runners.

infra-oncall: Confirmed base-image bumped nvidia driver 525 -> 535 in the nightly at 03:12 UTC. Some hosts didn't get matching kernel modules rebuilt; we're seeing Xid 31 / NVML timeouts on those.

lucas: I can bisect — would prefer to rerun the failing job on a single node to repro. Which test?

elle: test_inference_end_to_end::test_long_sequence is the one consistently failing. I kicked a rerun on host-12 with reduced parallelism.

cheng: Short-term mitigation: pin the CI image driver to 525 for the matrix until infra finishes the node rebuilds. I'll open a quick PR to pin and add a note.

elle: PR created to pin image: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-images/pull/790 — includes test skip for flaky host label. Rerun started with overrides.

ci-bot: Rerun started: gpu-inference-ubuntu-22.04 #4567.1 on host-12 (queued -> running).

infra-oncall: For manual recovery on a node: run `sudo dkms autoinstall` or `sudo dkms install -m nvidia -v 535` then reboot the node. We're rolling a fix to the image pipeline now.

sarah: Thanks — adding :eyes: to the PR and to the infra ticket. If rerun fails I'll escalate to oncall page.

elle: rerun completed — still failed with same Xid 31. I'll attach full logs to the infra ticket and start a bisect job across recent base-image commits.

lucas: If you want me to run the bisect let me know which commit range. I can spin up a repro on an isolated instance.

elle: I'll post the range in the ticket, thanks. Will update this thread when infra finishes the node rebuild and once the pinned-525 PR is merged. :+1:
